A small pill label for a short, read-only value.

**When to use.** Listing places or tags side by side ("Lisbon", "Osaka", "Quito"). It is not interactive.

**What you provide.** `children`, a word or two.

**Rules.** `slate-100` fill, `ink` text in `chip-label` (14px), `radius-full`, `space-3` by `space-1` padding. Lay Chips out in a flex row with an 8px gap.
